## Checklist

- [ ] The component is an HTML fragment
- [ ] The file contains exactly one root node
- [ ] The root includes `class="cmp"`, `data-cmp-id`, `role="img"`, and `aria-label`
- [ ] The file contains a valid `@cmp-manifest` block
- [ ] `manifest.id` matches `data-cmp-id`, and the id is globally unique
- [ ] No external assets are referenced
- [ ] CSS is fully scoped
- [ ] Key configuration is exposed through CSS variables with fallbacks
- [ ] Any JS is wrapped, self-contained, and only touches its own DOM
